epithet: who carried a stillness like a held breath
mannerisms: traces patterns in the air with a finger when bored
doubles back on conversations to test the echo
pauses three beats before answering anything difficult
speaks of certain things only at dusk
voice: low and unhurried, like sand settling
aspiration: to touch the ground beneath the ground one more time
fear: their children carrying the same hunger
wound: a sibling who did not survive the lean year
secret: that they no longer believe what they have been teaching

threads.desc: (theirs, or theirs by acclamation) who carries the same wound at half the speed
who never knew how thoroughly {name} listened
who is dying slowly enough that there is still time to do this correctly

backstory.origin: The story Kade tells about their beginnings starts in The Void Below, of the Unseamed, with two parents who agreed on almost nothing and stayed together anyway.
backstory.weight: Two generations back, the cupboard was actually empty more often than not. The memory of that emptiness travels — Kade's grandmother taught their mother to portion bread before tasting it, and the habit reaches Kade still.
backstory.fracture: It happened in a season when Kade should not have been alone, but was — at thirty, in a place they no longer name — and what they encountered there set the angle of their gaze permanently downward, toward the underneath.
backstory.between: They drifted through a stretch of years that produced fewer stories than the decade before. Kade grew quieter, then briefly louder, then quieter again. There was a project — a book — that almost worked.
backstory.present: Currently, Kade is keeping a promise that nobody else remembers, refusing to call the dead by anything other than their right names, and watching for for permission they will not, in the end, wait for. The plan, if one can call it that, is to do all three for as long as it takes.
